summary:
At `ababd98f`, **exact-prefix retrieval exists; the exposed greeting failures do not prove omission.** [PR #782](https://github.com/IsaacThoman/pulpo/pull/782) is linked.

- [SpellCorrector.swift:204](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/PulpoKeyboardKit/Sources/KeyboardCore/Correction/SpellCorrector.swift:204) records exact matching prefixes at zero cost. Exact and fuzzy descendants then compete for eight completion results under a 4,000-expansion cap. The preceding search also has a visit cap. Retrieval crowding is possible, but the greeting tests inspect only final top-eight membership, which also reflects ranking.
- [Suggester.swift:110](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/PulpoKeyboardKit/Sources/KeyboardCore/Correction/Suggester.swift:110) deliberately preserves correction evidence when the same text is also a completion. Keep this: `hav → have` must retain its edit cost and separator eligibility. Simply preferring zero-cost prefix matches would violate that contract.
- Filtering needs explicit attention. Trie completions exclude `.neverSuggest` but omit `.notAWord`; contextual completion insertion has the same gap. Blocked/rejected filtering runs through `add`, but rejection precedes case conversion, so rendered-case rejection requires verification.

**Smallest defensible candidate, conditional on demonstrated crowding:** retain current retrieval and scoring, then supplement with a separately bounded exact-node completion query using existing `Lexicon.node(forKey:)`, zero prefix cost, and a small fixed result/expansion budget. Merge through correction-preferred deduplication. Exclude both prohibited flags, blocked words, and rejected forms; require a strictly longer normalized key. Preserve display spelling, existing case/accent handling, and completion-only eligibility.

I would reject an unconditional exact-prefix boost, reserved visible slot, or larger global search budget at this stage. A separate lane cannot repair a target ranked below its own exact-prefix budget or legitimately below stronger corrections.

Development acceptance should establish:

- Where each miss occurs: search, completion cap, candidate merge, or visible-slot ranking.
- Better visible useful choices and net characters saved across varied exposed prefixes, contexts, and language modes—not just greeting/top-eight hits.
- Unchanged autocorrection decisions and correction precedence.
- Caps, deduplication, exclusions, case variants, apostrophes, and composed/decomposed accents, including heavily filtered candidate pools.

This was static review only; target-specific omission versus ranking remains unmeasured. I made no edits, ran no builds/tests, and read no audit payloads or production assets.
